WITH l AS (
  SELECT f.*, s.store_id, p.sku, cp.subcategory AS cur_sub, p.subcategory AS was_sub, cp.category AS cur_cat
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
)
SELECT cur_cat, cur_sub, was_sub, count(*) n_lines, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) n_ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) n_rl,
 sum(quantity) units, sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) staff_units,
 sum(CASE WHEN quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos, min(sale_date) mn, max(sale_date) mx, count(DISTINCT sale_date) days,
 max(etl_loaded_at) loaded, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) n_loads
FROM l WHERE cur_sub = 'Interior Paint' OR was_sub = 'Interior Paint'
GROUP BY ALL

WITH base AS (
  SELECT f.*, p.sku, cp.subcategory AS sub, cp.category AS cat
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
),
ctl AS (SELECT sum(units_sold) u, sum(receipts) r, sum(net_sales_before_returns) nsbr, count(*) d FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id = 108 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02')
SELECT 'fact_all' k, sum(quantity) a, count(DISTINCT receipt_id) b, sum(net_amount) c, count(*) d FROM base WHERE cat <> 'ZZ Test'
UNION ALL SELECT 'fact_ip', sum(quantity), NULL, sum(net_amount), count(*) FROM base WHERE sub='Interior Paint'
UNION ALL SELECT 'ctl', u, r, nsbr, d FROM ctl
UNION ALL SELECT 'ts_mismatch', count(*), NULL, NULL, NULL FROM base WHERE sub='Interior Paint' AND sale_date <> CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', sale_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns_ip', sum(r.quantity_returned), NULL, sum(r.refund_net), count(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN base b ON b.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id WHERE b.sub='Interior Paint'
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns_ip_in_period_store', sum(r.quantity_returned), NULL, sum(r.refund_net), count(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current WHERE s.store_id=108 AND cp.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'

SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_period, 108 AS store_id, st.store_name, 'Interior Paint' AS subcategory, sum(f.quantity) AS units_sold, max(f.quantity) AS max_line_qty
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = s.store_id AND st.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND cp.subcategory = 'Interior Paint' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 3
GROUP BY st.store_name
